decision.summary: Only one candidate temporary offset interval identified in E within allowed context [580,700]: a prolonged low-E platform (~620–655) followed by a sharp drop (~660–664) without clear cross-axis counterparts or observed return. The absence of a confirmed return (E remains low through last sample at index 700) prevents confirmation; status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets meet criteria.

Return behavior is unobserved beyond index 664 (last sample at 700 is still low: −6.00119 MAD), so status is uncertain.
